r: Deliver wealth management services to CITI PRIVATE BANK clients with guidance from the Banker teams.

Manage and execute client transactions with respect to business and individual banking, credit and investment products. Ensure transactions are completed within audit and compliance standards as well as timely.
Take ownership of client investigations (e.g., statement reporting issues and pricing inquiries) and collaborate with operational and middle office teams to ensure effective resolution.
Coordinate account maintenance for all products and reporting on WINS including address changes, telephone number updates, account status changes, rates and fee waivers.
Enforce banking policies and procedures to ensure operational integrity while maintaining high client satisfaction.
Proactively arrange and participate in client visits and perform service quality check-in calls to clients.
Obtain banker/client appointments to build upon existing or establish new relationships.
Identify and document new business opportunities for referral to banker or product specialist.
Perform responsibilities through proficient use Citi applications. Participate in service related process improvements.

Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

r: Ensure company and statutory requirements, along with applicable engineering standards, are identified and addressed in the Electrical equipment design across all Purchase Orders and Programmes.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant industry standards and ensure project designs comply with current requirements.
Ensure the technical integrity of Electrical discipline deliverables through checking, verification, and design review activities.
Proactively understand the safety hazards and risks associated with the asset lifecycle of the designed product, plant, or equipment.
Ensure actions arising from Project Reviews and Value Improvement Practices (VIPs) are addressed in a timely manner.
Design and develop innovative technical approaches to Electrical engineering challenges and contribute to continuous business improvement initiatives.
Communicate key design decisions with potential safety impacts to project teams and ensure they are appropriately documented.

Drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of project delivery through elimination, simplification, standardization, and automation while maintaining high-quality engineering outcomes.
Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of the OneWay™ framework and proactively promote it within the team to support Zero Harm Behaviour.
Plan the execution of discipline activities to maintain project schedules.
Manage quality and consistency within the discipline.
Provide technical direction, control, and supervision for engineering and design activities.
Prepare discipline man-hour estimates for proposals and develop deliverables lists.
Deliver discipline design deliverables within approved man-hour budgets.
Manage discipline resources in collaboration with the Project Engineering Manager.
Identify software requirements and select appropriate design tools.
Identify training and development needs of discipline personnel.
Perform or delegate checking of deliverables.
Report progress on deliverables and tasks and provide updates for project reporting.
Identify and report potential project variances.
Maintain and update lessons learned registers.
Undertake or delegate site visits as required.
Manage interfaces within the discipline, across other disciplines, and with third-party contractors.
Interface with procurement and construction teams.
Coordinate change control and technical query processes within the discipline.
